locator: FIG. 3, p. 782, abscissa tick printed “20” (second from the right-hand end)
evidence: The 14 abscissa ticks were located in the embedded bitmap. Fitting log10(frequency) to pixel column over the other 13 printed labels leaves a residual of +10.4% at this tick if its value is 20 kHz, but +0.07% if it is 22.5 kHz (all other residuals then <= 0.9%). The Results text (p. 781) names 22.5 kHz as a test frequency: "Thresholds remained at 25 dB SPL or better up to 22.5 kHz".
note: The CSV keeps the printed label 20 in frequency_kHz; the position-implied 22.5 kHz is carried alongside in frequency_kHz_from_tick_position.
